title: daily-budget-{YYYY-MM-DD}.json
description: Per-UTC-day token-budget ledger written by the kill-switch skill's record-budget subcommand and read by its poll subcommand. One file per day at .claude/state/daily-budget-{YYYY-MM-DD}.json. Lifecycle is per-day, NOT per-issue — multiple issues run on the same day share one ledger. Pruned on session start once older than 30 days.

date.description: UTC date this ledger covers, in YYYY-MM-DD form. Matches the filename suffix.

consumed_tokens.description: Running total of tokens consumed this UTC day across all autonomous runs. Compared against ceiling_tokens to fire HALT-007 (daily).

runs.description: Append-only audit trail of individual record-budget increments. One entry per dispatch.

issue.description: GitHub Issue number this dispatch was charged to.

tokens.description: Tokens consumed by this dispatch alone.

ts.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with millisecond precision when the increment was recorded.

ceiling_tokens.description: Daily ceiling captured from MAKATO_DAILY_TOKEN_BUDGET at first write of the day. Omitted entirely when the env var is unset — in that case the daily HALT check is a no-op.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent record-budget call.
